instruction: With the model open in SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_06_hex_plate.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. In this image, launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_06_hex_plate.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. All dimensions and coordinates below are in millimeters (mm). Use the construction marks in the file to create a regular hexagonal plate with top and bottom edges horizontal and circumradius 40. Add one center hole of diameter 20. Add one diameter 6 hole near each left and right vertex. From each corresponding vertex, place the hole center 12 mm inward along the horizontal direction toward the hexagon center: the left hole center must be at (12,40), and the right hole center must be at (68,40). Add six diameter 4 holes equally spaced on a bolt circle of radius 25 around the hexagon center, starting at the positive X direction. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_06.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
